displayName: OCI-AI-RAG-002: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Adversarial Documents
description:
Detects adversarial documents in RAG stores designed to manipulate retrieval results

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — rag retrieval manipulation via adversarial do

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_rag_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%rag%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%retrieval%') AND "value" > 0
